The '''Thul Navy''' was the aquatic military force of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bevek Thul]] was an officer in the navy.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|I Spy|Alderaan}}</ref>
